answer.says: Masterji, you are too kind. The separation of the object from the crowd is a small mercy, but I accept it. I have no further need today.
answer.thought: The heat has broken, and the air is cool enough to think. I have eaten enough; the body is satisfied, and now it is time to return to the bungalow. The file is a knot that will not loosen until Friday, and my head is clear enough to walk back.
